about: Per-light decisions for the P04 scores REVERT (lighting_scores_apply.py, 'Per-light drift decisions'). One entry per drifted light the drift report could NOT attribute (class UNKNOWN = inferred hand edit). Attributed drift (RIG_LAMP_DROP etc.) is not decided here: revert that tool first.
how_to_decide: Set each 'decision' to keep / overwrite / fold (see that light's 'options'), then set status to DECIDED and decided_by to who decided (Gary). Leave row_hash alone: it pins the live row this decision is about; REVERT refuses if the light changed since.

options.keep: REVERT never writes this lamp (the score kept it lit): it stays exactly as it is now
options.overwrite: same as keep: the live row is accepted as the pre-score baseline
options.fold: NOT POSSIBLE: not a score lamp
